methodologies.name: HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study)
methodologies.summary: Systematic technique for identifying potential hazards and operability problems in process plant. Uses guide words (MORE, LESS, NO, REVERSE, OTHER THAN) applied to process parameters.

methodologies.name: LOPA (Layer of Protection Analysis)
methodologies.summary: Semi-quantitative risk analysis method that assesses independent protection layers (IPL) to determine whether risk is reduced to tolerable level. Used to determine SIL requirements.

methodologies.name: Bowtie Analysis
methodologies.standard: No single standard; based on barrier-based risk management
methodologies.summary: Visual risk assessment tool showing causal factors on left (fault tree) and consequences on right (event tree) connected through a top event. Barriers shown as controls.

methodologies.name: Fire and Explosion Index (F&EI)
methodologies.standard: Dow Chemical Fire and Explosion Index Guide (7th Ed.)
methodologies.summary: Quantitative hazard ranking index for fire, explosion, and reactivity hazards in chemical process operations.
